home.subtitle: Join our community. Fill out the digital form and support our social promotion projects.

loginCard.emailCheck: Check your email to confirm registration!

howItWorks.title: How membership works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Login with Google or register to create your private area.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Fill in your details in the wizard, entering personal data and a valid document.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Pay the fee with the accepted payment methods and select the amount and method in the request. Valid for 12 months.

benefits.title: Benefits for our members
benefits.resourceDesc: Get immediate access to all tools, educational materials and services provided by the association.
benefits.communityDesc: Participate in group events, assemblies and social activities together with other enthusiasts.
benefits.supportDesc: Actively participate by proposing initiatives and giving us your support for local volunteer projects.

statusIncomplete.title: Profile to complete
statusIncomplete.desc: Welcome! To submit your application and get your membership card, you must complete the steps of the registration form.

statusPending.title: Request processing
statusPending.desc: Your registration is awaiting payment verification and formal approval from the board of directors. You will receive a notification email once approved.

statusRejected.title: Request rejected
statusRejected.desc: Your application to join the association has been rejected.
statusRejected.info: For more information, contact the secretary office.
